messages:
elena (Finance): Quick sync 1: proposing a small canary to convert legacy partner fixed-dollar discounts into percent-tier discounts for invoices. Aim: spot rendering, tax, and recognition issues before wide rollout.

ryan (Billing): Agreed. Suggest 2% of eligible partners as A/B: A = fixed-dollar, B = percent. Exclude named accounts, custom SOWs, and >30d terms.

tom (Product): 14-day run sounds right. Also preserve a memo on converted lines for reconciliation.

nora (RevOps): I will randomize cohort and exclude accounts with collections flags. Will also prepare dashboard (revenue delta, tax delta, negative-line events, partner tickets).

elena (Finance): Legal check needed on contract riders that mandate fixed discounts. @lucy please export flagged contracts.

lucy (Legal): On it. Any partner with explicit fixed-dollar clause will be auto-excluded unless sales confirms consent.

ryan (Billing): Preview run started. Output CSV with fields: account_id, invoice_id, before_lines, after_lines, tax_delta, memo. Adding memo `LEG_DISC_CONV_189123`.

billing-bot: job: preview-invoice-render queued (q_92).

ryan (Billing): Preview complete: processed=2,132; negative_line_items=16; tax_alerts=62. 16 accounts have percent conversion producing negative net lines (rounding/ordering issues).

elena (Finance): Those 16 are blockers. For now keep fixed-dollar for them and flag for engineering fix. Also, treat the percent-conversion as a contract modification for recognition mapping.

lucy (Legal): Contracts export shows 58 flagged partners; excluded. I'll send list to sales.

nora (RevOps): Cohort adjusted: final A/B footprint ~1.7% of partners. Dashboard link: https://go.redwood/revops/legacy-partner-canary. Setting alerts: negative_line_items > 10 or tax_alerts > 50.

tom (Product): Decision gates proposed: revenue delta > 2% OR negative_line_items rate > 0.5% OR > 10 partner tickets per 1k in 7d.

elena (Finance): Add soft gate: >5% invoices require manual accounting adjustments.

ryan (Billing): One implementation note: persist computed percent per billing period to ensure archived invoice determinism.

elena (Finance): Agreed. Next steps:
- Ryan: share preview CSV and bad-account list (done)
- Lucy: legal contract exceptions (ETA EOD)
- Nora: cohort + dashboard (done)
- Tom: partner-facing copy (drafting)
We meet tomorrow 9am PT to decide on a tiny live canary (~500 partners).

billing-bot: alert monitor created: legacy-partner-canary-monitor (thresholds configured).

elena (Finance): Keep partner messaging simple: opt-out, contact support, no technical details. No mention of A/B. Thanks team.
